Enum Class MeasureKey

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<MeasureKey>
network.ike.tooling.buildreport.MeasureKey
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<MeasureKey>, Constable
public enum MeasureKey extends Enum<MeasureKey>
The measures the extension derives from a session itself, by their stable keys (ike-issues#1207).

A key names one quantity for the life of the project: the ledger bounds it, the sidecar records it, and TeamCity charts it under that name, so a key is never renamed once published. Keys a build adds from outside — a size the ledger names, a measurement a test leaves in target/measurements/ — are not enumerated here; they are as the ledger or the test wrote them.
